newsitem.title: USA: Rockford says restates Q2, Q3 net.
newsitem.headline: Rockford says restates Q2, Q3 net.

text.p: Rockford Industries Inc said it restated second and third quarter net income lower to reflect sales of direct finance leases in its portfolio.

It also determined that initial direct costs of $293,000 in the second quarter and $367,000 in the third quarter that were previously capitalized should have reduced the gains recorded upon the sale of the leases.

These adjustments will have no impact on prior or future periods, it said. Net income for the second quarter, as restated, was $754,000, or $0.17 per share, versus $930,000 or $0.21 per share, as previously reported. Third quarter net income, as restated, was $752,000 or $0.17 per share, as compared with $972,000 or $0.22 per share, as previously reported.
